def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    max_cap = np.max(bins)
    used = max_cap - bins
    scores = np.where(rem >= 0, -rem - np.exp(-rem) - 0.15 * np.log1p(used / max_cap), -np.inf)
    empty_mask = (bins == max_cap) & (rem >= 0)
    if np.any(empty_mask):
        first_empty = np.argmax(empty_mask)
        scores[first_empty] = -max_cap * 0.45
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    max_cap = np.max(bins)
    used = max_cap - bins
    fill_ratio = np.where(max_cap > 0, used / max_cap, 0.0)
    avg_fill = np.mean(fill_ratio[used > 0]) if np.any(used > 0) else 0.0
    scores = np.where(valid, -np.exp(rem / max_cap) + fill_ratio, -np.inf)
    empty_mask = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    if np.any(empty_mask):
        first_empty = np.argmax(empty_mask)
        scores[first_empty] = -1.5 - avg_fill
    return scores
